FUNCTION FIRST_NON_REPEATING_CHARACTER ACCEPTS(s)
  char_count <- EMPTY DICTIONARY
  FOR c IN s
    IF c IN char_count THEN
      char_count[c] <- char_count[c] + 1
    ELSE
      char_count[c] <- 1
    END IF
  END FOR
  FOR c IN s
    IF char_count[c] == 1 THEN
      RETURN c
    END IF
  END FOR
  RETURN NULL
END FUNCTION
